name: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus Quotes

quotes.quote:
The democratization of technology allows anyone to be a creator, entrepreneur, scientist. The future is brighter.
科技的大众化使得任何人都可以成为创造者、企业家、科学家。未来会更加光明。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: BONUS

quotes.quote:
It's statistically likely there are more advanced alien civilizations out there. Hopefully, they're good environmentalists and find us cute.
从统计学上看，更加先进的外星文明很可能存在。
希望他们是善良的环保主义者，而且觉得我们很可爱。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: BONUS

quotes.quote:
The truth is, I don't read for self-improvement. I read out of curiosity and interest. The best book is the one you'll devour.
我阅读不是为了自我提升，而是出于好奇心和兴趣。最好的书就是让人欲罢不能、爱不释手的书。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S RECOMMENDED READING

quotes.quote:
Read enough, and you become a connoisseur. Then you naturally gravitate more toward theory, concepts, nonfiction.
大量阅读可以提高阅读品位，然后你会自然地开始阅读更多理论、概念和非虚构类作品。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S RECOMMENDED READING

quotes.quote:
I once asked a monk how he found peace.
“I say 'yes,'” he'd said. “To all that happens, I say 'yes.'”
我曾经问一个和尚，他是如何找到内心的平静的。
他说：“无论发生什么，我都说‘好的’。”
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S RECOMMENDED READING

quotes.quote:
Happiness = Health + Wealth + Good Relationships
幸福=健康+财富+良好的人际关系
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S WRITING – LIFE FORMULAS I

quotes.quote:
Health = Exercise + Diet + Sleep
健康=锻炼+饮食+睡眠
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S WRITING – LIFE FORMULAS I

quotes.quote:
Wealth = Income + Wealth * (Return on Investment)
财富=收入+财富×（投资回报率）
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S WRITING – LIFE FORMULAS I

quotes.quote:
Income = Accountability + Leverage + Specific Knowledge
收入=责任+杠杆+专长
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S WRITING – LIFE FORMULAS I

quotes.quote:
Leverage = Capital + People + Intellectual Property
杠杆=资本+人力+知识产权
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S WRITING – LIFE FORMULAS I

quotes.quote:
Be present above all else.
人生要义：活在当下。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S WRITING – NAVAL'S RULES

quotes.quote:
Truth is that which has predictive power.
真理是具有预测能力的理论。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S WRITING – NAVAL'S RULES

quotes.quote:
All greatness comes from suffering.
生命的伟大在很大程度上源于苦难。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S WRITING – NAVAL'S RULES

quotes.quote:
Love is given, not received.
爱是给予，不是接受。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S WRITING – NAVAL'S RULES

quotes.quote:
Mathematics is the language of nature.
数学是自然的语言。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S WRITING – NAVAL'S RULES

quotes.quote:
Every moment has to be complete in and of itself.
每一刻都自成一体，自有意义。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S WRITING – NAVAL'S RULES

quotes.quote:
Health, love, and your mission, in that order. Nothing else matters.
健康、爱和使命，以此为序，其他的都不重要。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Bonus, Section: NAVAL'S WRITING – NAVAL'S RULES
